svg.title: Psychrometric processes: heating, cooling, humidification, dehumidification, evaporative cooling, sorbent dehumidification and condensation

g.text: a · Directions of change from P
b · Cooling below the dew point (Szokolay)
Horizontal: sensible heat only. Vertical: moisture (latent heat). Evaporative cooling follows a wet-bulb line; a sorbent moves the point along an enthalpy line.
